report:
WarriorCon 6 — report for Nov 26 (updated Nov 27, 7:13am ET)

SUMMARY
• 4 new tickets yesterday (2 paid + 2 brothers; 181 total, 5 days to go)
• Win: 85 of 167 paid + comp ticket holders (50.9%) signed up for the Warrior App (free until Dec 4)
• Watch: promote texts not delivered 23.6% to date (33,239 of 140,829 texts not delivered), above 5%. Main cause: 20,693 of 33,239 (62%) blocked by GHL's Texas SMS safeguard.

LEFT TO SEND (until Dec 2)
Promote: 4 emails · 4 texts — next: Sat Nov 28, 6:00am ET
Ticket holders: 3 emails · 3 texts — next: Sat Nov 28, 11:30am ET
Bring Your Brother: 2 emails · 3 texts — next: Fri Nov 27, 2:00pm ET

TICKET HOLDERS: 181 (164 paid + 3 comps + 14 brothers) · 4 new yesterday
Refunds: 0 to date
$35,561 total sales ($32,636 tickets + $2,925 Business Bible)
125 of 164 tickets were bought within 48 hrs of an email/text

BRING YOUR BROTHER (free friend tickets)
Yesterday: 2 claimed · 0 added the Warrior App
To date: 14 claimed · 1 added the Warrior App (7%)

PROMOTE (non-ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 22,374 sent · 26.0% open · 0.2% click
Yesterday — SMS: 3,489 sent · 82.4% delivered
To date — Email: 780,165 sent · 30.9% open · 0.3% click
To date — SMS: 140,829 sent · 76.0% delivered

POST-TICKET SEDUCTION (ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 152 sent · 32.9% open
Yesterday — SMS: 120 sent · 85.8% delivered
To date — Email: 2,642 sent · 43.6% open
To date — SMS: 1,871 sent · 86.9% delivered

BRING YOUR BROTHER INVITES (ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 148 sent · 36.6% open
Yesterday — SMS: 106 sent · 87.7% delivered
To date — Email: 585 sent · 41.3% open
To date — SMS: 318 sent · 87.4% delivered

UPSELLS
Warrior App (Power Plan): 85 · 50.9% of paid + comp ticket holders
Business Bible: 27 sales · $2,925 · bought by 26 of 164 paid buyers (15.9%)
